--[[ Helper function to create a series from arrays
new_series: a series previously created with ScatterXY.new(name) prefix: prefix of the timeseries, before the index of the array suffix_X: suffix to complete the name of the series containing the X value. If [nil], use the index of the array. suffix_Y: suffix to complete the name of the series containing the Y value timestamp: usually the tracker_time variable
Example:
Assuming we have multiple series in the form:
/trajectory/node.{X}/position/x /trajectory/node.{X}/position/y
where {N} is the index of the array (integer). We can create a reactive series from the array with:
new_series = ScatterXY.new("my_trajectory") CreateSeriesFromArray( new_series, "/trajectory/node", "position/x", "position/y", tracker_time ); --]]
function CreateSeriesFromArray( new_series, prefix, suffix_X, suffix_Y, timestamp )
--- clear previous values new_series:clear()
--- Append points to new_series index = 0 while(true) do
x = index; -- if not nil, get the X coordinate from a series if suffix_X ~= nil then series_x = TimeseriesView.find( string.format( "%s.%d/%s", prefix, index, suffix_X) ) if series_x == nil then break end x = series_x:atTime(timestamp) end
series_y = TimeseriesView.find( string.format( "%s.%d/%s", prefix, index, suffix_Y) ) if series_y == nil then break end y = series_y:atTime(timestamp)
new_series:push_back(x,y) index = index+1 end end
--[[ Similar to the built-in function GetSeriesNames(), but select only the names with a give prefix. --]]
function GetSeriesNamesByPrefix(prefix) -- GetSeriesNames(9 is a built-in function all_names = GetSeriesNames() filtered_names = {} for i, name in ipairs(all_names) do -- check the prefix if name:find(prefix, 1, #prefix) then table.insert(filtered_names, name); end end return filtered_names end
--[[ Modify an existing series, applying offsets to all their X and Y values
series: an existing timeseries, obtained with TimeseriesView.find(name) delta_x: offset to apply to each x value delta_y: offset to apply to each y value
--]]
function ApplyOffsetInPlace(series, delta_x, delta_y) -- use C++ indeces, not Lua indeces for index=0, series:size()-1 do x,y = series:at(index) series:set(index, x + delta_x, y + delta_y) end end

script.global:
local NODES = { [0x03] = "Front_Steering", [0x07] = "Rear_Steering", [0x04] = "Front_Traction", [0x08] = "Rear_Traction" }
local PARAM_MAP = { [0x6040] = { sub = 0x00, name = "Controlword" }, [0x6060] = { sub = 0x00, name = "Traction_Mode" }, [0x3003] = { sub = 0x00, name = "Steering_Mode" }, [0x3004] = { sub = 0x00, name = "Steering_State" }, [0x3300] = { sub = 0x00, name = "Steering_Profile_Velocity" }, [0x60FF] = { sub = 0x00, name = "Traction_Velocity" }, [0x3790] = { sub = 0x00, name = "Steering_Position" },
-- Feedback Indices (from 0x43 Replies) [0x606C] = { sub = 0x01, name = "Traction_Velocity" }, [0x3A04] = { sub = 0x01, name = "Steering_Velocity" }, [0x6041] = { sub = 0x00, name = "Traction_Statusword" }, [0x3762] = { sub = 0x00, name = "Steering_Position" } }
-- SDO Command Specifiers local CMD_WRITE_4B = 0x23 -- Setpoint (Master to Slave) local CMD_REPLY_4B = 0x43 -- Feedback (Slave to Master)
-- Helper function to decode a specific CAN stream local function ProcessCANStream(topic_prefix, is_rx, output_series) local id_series = TimeseriesView.find(topic_prefix .. "/id") local data = {}
for b = 0, 7 do data[b] = TimeseriesView.find(topic_prefix .. "/data." .. b) end
if id_series == nil then return end
for i = 0, id_series:size() - 1 do local timestamp = id_series:atTime(i) local can_id = id_series:at(i)
-- ========================================================= -- CAN ID DECODING: 0x580 for Feedback, 0x600 for Setpoints -- ========================================================= local base_id = is_rx and 0x580 or 0x600 local node_id = can_id - base_id
local motor_name = NODES[node_id]
-- If the calculated Node ID matches our dictionary, process it if motor_name ~= nil then
-- Safely extract Bytes 0 to 3 local byte0 = (data[0] ~= nil) and data[0]:atTime(timestamp) or 0 local byte1 = (data[1] ~= nil) and data[1]:atTime(timestamp) or 0 local byte2 = (data[2] ~= nil) and data[2]:atTime(timestamp) or 0 local byte3 = (data[3] ~= nil) and data[3]:atTime(timestamp) or 0
if output_series['byte0'] == nil then output_series['byte0'] = Timeseries.new(target_series_name) end
output_series['byte0']:push_back(byte0) -- Calculate Parameter Index (Little Endian: Byte 1 + Byte 2 shifted) local index = byte1 + (byte2 * 256) local subindex = byte3
local is_valid_msg = false local msg_type = ""
-- Classify as Setpoint or Feedback if not is_rx and byte0 == CMD_WRITE_4B then is_valid_msg = true msg_type = "_Setpoint" elseif is_rx and byte0 == CMD_REPLY_4B then is_valid_msg = true msg_type = "_Feedback" end
-- Match the Index/Subindex to our dictionary local param_info = PARAM_MAP[index]
if is_valid_msg and param_info ~= nil and param_info.sub == subindex then
-- Construct the target plot name (e.g., "Steering_1_Velocity_Feedback") local target_series_name = motor_name .. "_" .. param_info.name .. msg_type
-- Ensure series exists in our output table if output_series[target_series_name] == nil then output_series[target_series_name] = Timeseries.new(target_series_name) end
-- Extract 32-bit Data Payload (Bytes 4, 5, 6, 7) local b4 = (data[4] ~= nil) and data[4]:atTime(timestamp) or 0 local b5 = (data[5] ~= nil) and data[5]:atTime(timestamp) or 0 local b6 = (data[6] ~= nil) and data[6]:atTime(timestamp) or 0 local b7 = (data[7] ~= nil) and data[7]:atTime(timestamp) or 0
local extracted_value = b4 + (b5 * 256) + (b6 * 65536) + (b7 * 16777216)
-- Convert to signed 32-bit integer if extracted_value >= 2147483648 then extracted_value = extracted_value - 4294967296 end
-- Push the value to the plot output_series[target_series_name]:push_back(timestamp, 1.0) end end end end
-- Main Function function DecodeAllMotors(can_rx_topic, can_tx_topic) local output_series = {}
-- Process the Receive (Feedback) stream [is_rx = true] -- This flags the processor to look for 0x580 + Node IDs ProcessCANStream(can_rx_topic, true, output_series)
-- Process the Transmit (Setpoint) stream [is_rx = false] -- This flags the processor to look for 0x600 + Node IDs ProcessCANStream(can_tx_topic, false, output_series)
return output_series end
-- ============================================================================== -- EXECUTE SCRIPT -- ============================================================================== return DecodeAllMotors("mobotic/can_tx", "mobotic/can_rx")
